text:
Morgan: quick sync — I'm building a dependency map for the upcoming pen-test retest. need to know which services require KMS decrypt during assessment and which teams need ephemeral RBAC grants. keeping this lightweight, replying here avoids meetings.
Jamal: thanks — can you list what you already have?
Morgan: initial pass: api-gateway, model-store, telemetry-ingest, eval-runner, embeddings-worker. model-store + eval-runner need KMS DECRYPT for model keys; telemetry-ingest needs write-only log keys; api-gateway no KMS except TLS certs (handled by infra).
Sasha: for model-store, do you mean customer model encryption or service-side model keys? big difference for evidence.
Morgan: service-side model keys (we rotate monthly). customer models are out of scope for this PT.
Rebecca: FYI — retest window is Tue 2026-04-07 09:00-13:00 UTC per calendar. ops asked for a 30m dry-run Fri 2026-04-03 16:00 UTC. sec-bot: retest-window created: https://calendar.redwood/r/ret-4791234567
Jamal: for RBAC plan: propose ephemeral role grants via short-lived SSO token + policy scoping. sample policy snippet I used in staging: 
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["kms:Decrypt"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh"
  }]
}
```
Sasha: awesome. we need these role names: pt-assessor-readonly, pt-assessor-decrypt, pt-assessor-logview. ensure no write perms except log upload endpoints.
Morgan: noted. also we need to confirm audit logging endpoints and retention. telemetry team: do we capture KMSDecrypt events in our SIEM?
Rebecca: yes, CloudTrail logs KMS API calls; we forward to SIEM with 90d hot retention. for retest we can enable a separate bucket for raw audit export.
Jamal: how will assessors access evidence? presigned S3 links or read-only console? prefer presigned links to avoid broad console grants.
Sasha: presigned links + timeboxed IAM conditions + signed evidence manifest. we'll collect checksums in the manifest. example command to generate presigned url: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/4791234567/model-seed.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
```
Morgan: good. also need step for revoking ephemeral roles post-window. recommend automation: oncall-bot runs a revoke job at window end. oncall-bot: can you schedule a revoke job?
oncall-bot: revoke job scheduled: run at 2026-04-07T13:05:00Z, job id rev-4791234567 :white_check_mark:
Rebecca: for the dry-run, ops will simulate assessor login and attempt KMS decrypts. checklist for dry-run: 1) create ephemeral creds 2) attempt decrypt model key 3) fetch presigned evidence 4) validate audit entries in SIEM 5) capture screenshots for evidence handoff.
Morgan: perfect. one last ask — are there any cross-account KMS keys (partner account) that require a trust policy change?
Jamal: yes, embeddings-worker reads a key in partner account acct-8888. I'll open a small PR to add a limited key policy allowing the pt-assessor-decrypt role; will link here once ready.
Sasha: tagging docs request — can someone export the dependency map into the repo under infra/pt-retest/depmap.md? I can draft after Jamal's PR.
Morgan: I'll create the first draft and push to PR after Jamal's key-policy PR is merged.
Rebecca: last note: please avoid embedding private key material in the evidence bundle. checksums only. :eyes:
Morgan: thanks all — action items summarized: Jamal -> key-policy PR + policy snippet; Sasha -> evidence manifest template; Rebecca -> create audit export bucket & schedule; oncall-bot -> revoke job (confirmed). meeting only if dry-run fails. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: reminder: open vuln tickets should be assigned to "pt-triage" label and linked to retest ticket 4791234567.
